mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed trace is the graph of g. Right image: The dashed arc denotes the hidden part of the circular base rim of the hemisphere.
Rationales: The feature plots the values of a function in the left image and shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the right image. The dashed magenta parabola labeled g, with a vertex left of the y-axis. The elliptical rear arc of the hemisphere’s base drawn with dashes.
